notes: The biggest correction here is not a lint item: five fields told the reader Zoe has no dash and never gains mobility. She has Portal Jump on 11/8/5 — a 1-second blink that returns her to where she started. It is not an escape, but it does dodge an arriving Death Mark, and that distinction is now what the page says. Also added the two mechanics the sleep actually turns on: reduced Magic Resist while asleep and a doubled first damage source breaking it. The suspectNames hit was real — the ability is Paddle Star! with the exclamation mark. Not written despite the missing-interactions file suggesting it: the 'bypasses stacking resistances' framing for the bubble. Riot's text says the sleep reduces Magic Resist and doubles the waking hit, which is not the same as ignoring resistances, and Zed's damage is largely physical.

unlandableEdits.before: Sleep into empowered Q is the entire kill pattern — body-block it with minions or terrain. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
unlandableEdits.after: Sleep into an empowered Paddle Star! is the whole kill pattern — body-block the bubble with minions. Until that 18s is spent, every commit is a coin flip.
